proposal.reason: Primary change is in the IB network backend (connect/accept handshake state machine, ECE negotiation, FLID/GID routing, traffic-class handling, receive reporting, and MR registration cache), which is core network transport behavior. Add gin because there are independently substantive GIN-path changes (GIN IB connect/accept/cancel integration, listener-close/cancellation semantics, and GIN-specific accept traffic-class handling) beyond mechanical callsite updates.
